hero.description: A battle-tested Next.js App Router frontend architected with defense-in-depth security, shadcn/ui, Better-Auth, and strict Zod validation — built to pair seamlessly with our NestJS backend.

features.sectionDesc: Every layer is hardened against vulnerabilities, optimized for zero layout shifts, and engineered for high developer velocity.
features.securityDesc: Strict Content Security Policy (CSP), HSTS, anti-clickjacking frameguard, sanitization, and correlation tracing.
features.performanceDesc: Next.js App Router with Server Components, optimized font rendering, and zero unnecessary client JS bundles.
features.authDesc: Session-backed security with HTTP-only cookies, OAuth social authentication, and strong password hashing.
features.seoDesc: Dynamic metadata, JSON-LD structured schemas, automatic XML sitemap, and search engine crawler directives.
features.backendDesc: Designed to directly consume our enterprise NestJS backend with shared DTO contracts and correlation tracing.
features.scaleDesc: Fully accessible Radix UI primitives with Tailwind v4 CSS variables, dark mode, and customizable palettes.
